prompts.gate-staffed:
STANDING: an operator in the chair or the crew is stranded.
Look: mark_gate_open, who is free.
order_pawn the nearest free pawn to any of the four consoles.
Refused: order_pawn with no option to list the labels; try the next console.
DONE: ladder_set mark operator_on_station true.
Owner: "you need to get your peopel back befoer they die in the backrooms"
prompts.br-out-of-the-backrooms:
LIVE (start_kind 7): get out of the backrooms. Look: game_state, then game_set cmd rooms.
0) ladder_set mark explore_tried false.
1) game_set cmd explore, time running; repeat until it says nothing left.
2) game_set cmd rooms; read every room for a natural gate/portal.
3) game_get_cells_info on the candidate; it must be a natural gate.
Refused or nothing found: ladder_set mark explore_tried true (3 -> br-out-fallback).
DONE: ladder_set mark natural_gate_found true (+ natural_gate_cell); latch br_out_of_the_backrooms_done.
Owner: "get out of the backrooms first find gats natural and GET OUT!"
Owner: "lock for gates and go through them come back to this level if they lead deerer ur exit is on this level"
prompts.br-out-fallback:
LIVE: explore came up empty 3 times. Look at game_take_screenshot + game_list_zones first.
0) ladder_set mark explore_tried false.
1) order_pawn one armed pawn to the farthest unexplored door, then game_set cmd explore.
2) A gate deeper than this level: through, mark home, come BACK.
Refused order: order_pawn without option to read the menu labels; refused again: ladder_set mark explore_tried true.
DONE: ladder_set mark natural_gate_found true.
Owner: "lock for gates and go through them come back to this level if they lead deerer ur exit is on this level"
prompts.br-haul-out:
LIVE: haul everything out through the natural gate.
1) game_set cmd unforbid (backrooms map). 2) order_pawn 'Haul' each stack, queue=true, walk it through the gate.
3) Surface: game_set cmd stockpile_camp mode food, then mode nofood, beside the gate shell.
Refused haul: order_pawn with no option to list the menu, pick the haul label.
Never leave a pawn behind.
DONE: every colonist on the surface -> ladder_set mark got_out true + ladder_set mark start_opening_done true; latch br_haul_out_done.
Owner: "okay if u found way out try to get all your supplies out and into starting structure that will become your main center throne roome"
prompts.br-natural-gate-room:
ONCE after getting out: the natural gate room is not a home.
Look: game_list_zones and beds near natural_gate_cell.
1) Delete any stockpile there. 2) game_set cmd set_bed_owner to move any owned bed elsewhere.
Natural gates stay open; never send a pawn out one expecting to come back.
Refused delete: game_take_screenshot, select the zone, game_list_selected_gizmos.
DONE: latch br_natural_gate_room_done.
Owner: "and you shouldnet be living in or using the natural gate room"
prompts.br-camp-wall:
LIVE (start_kind 7): the camp's wooden wall. Look: game_get_cells_info along the line.
0) ladder_set mark wall_tried false.
1) game_apply_architect_designator Wall (Wood), exterior only; Embrasure (non-powered) all round.
2) Gates east and west; 3-wide smooth marble firebreak outside; inner lane clear.
Refused: ladder_set mark wall_tried true (3 -> br-camp-wall-fallback).
DONE: ladder_set mark camp_defence true; latch br_camp_wall_done.
Owner: "make it of wood just exterior make 3wide terrriom stone smooth marble for fire break"
Owner: "make wall of embrasure non powered type all around then u can shoot out"
Owner: "wtf why u putting walls upganets and replacing embrasures that wont work fix those walls"
prompts.br-camp-wall-fallback:
LIVE: the wall build refused 3 times.
0) ladder_set mark wall_tried false.
1) game_list_architect_designators for the exact Wall / Embrasure / flagstone labels.
2) Wood short: game_set cmd chop, then retry one segment.
Refused again: ladder_set mark wall_tried true.
DONE: ladder_set mark camp_defence true.
Owner: "wtf why u putting walls upganets and replacing embrasures that wont work fix those walls"
prompts.br-contact-company:
LIVE: get in contact with the company.
Look: comms_console > 0. game_open_main_tab Operations, then game_get_ui_layout.
game_click_ui_target 'Found a company branch here'.
Refused: game_close_window, reopen, read the layout again.
DONE: ladder_set mark company_contact true; latch br_contact_company_done.
Owner: "try to find natural gate to it or just out of back rooms and get in contact with the company"
prompts.br-sustainable:
INTERLOCK: no gate before the colony is sustainable.
Look: days_of_food, has_power, defences_built, alert_low_medicine -- held 72 game hours.
Nothing to build here; if it never holds, the food/power/defence/medicine rungs are the fix.
DONE: ladder_set mark colony_sustainable true; latch br_sustainable_done.
Owner: "you are no FUCKING WHERE CLOSE TO SUSTAINABLITY BEFORE BUILDING A GATE!"
prompts.br-gate-facility:
LIVE: build the gate FACILITY first, not the gate.
Look: game_take_screenshot of the lab site; game_get_cells_info its footprint.
0) ladder_set mark facility_tried false.
1) Shell + roof. 2) Gate cell centred. 3) Ballistic-glass control room. 4) Two doors in line, one path.
5) Shooting galleries from inside only. 6) 2-wide hall east+north, counter-clockwise.
Refused: ladder_set mark facility_tried true (3 -> br-gate-facility-fallback).
DONE: ladder_set mark gate_facility_built true; latch br_gate_facility_done.
Owner: "the gaste needs to be center s int he room not the door between the control room and gate room"
Owner: "you need a whooel facility within your facility contain secure protect embrashurs ballistic glass all of it"
prompts.br-gate-facility-fallback:
LIVE: the facility build refused 3 times.
0) ladder_set mark facility_tried false.
1) game_list_architect_designators for exact labels; retry the one that refused.
2) Short of steel/plasteel/components: br-company-supply.
Refused again: ladder_set mark facility_tried true.
DONE: ladder_set mark gate_facility_built true (from br-gate-facility).
Owner: "you need a whooel facility within your facility contain secure protect embrashurs ballistic glass all of it"
prompts.rung-5b-the-gate:
LIVE: designate the gate door.
Look: the centre door of the gate room; game_list_selected_gizmos on it.
1) game_execute_gizmo the gate gizmo (designate_gate missing). 2) PowerSwitch outside the room = kill switch.
Refused: it must be the facility's centre door -- check mark_gate_facility_built.
DONE: ladder_set mark gate_designated true; latch rung_5b_the_gate_done.
Owner: "you only  need to assenble the gate once poer gate and like i fucking said u need it in a facitlity not a broom closet"
Owner: "you need to be testing all three scenerios trying to get a gate built in all three"
prompts.rung-5c-the-backrooms:
LIVE: one scout crosses.
Look: scout health, a meal and medicine carried, hostiles_on_map 0.
1) order_pawn the scout to the gate. 2) game_set cmd explore on that map. 3) Record route, distortion, entity.
ladder_set mark crew_across true while over. Home before the window closes.
Refused: order_pawn with no option to list labels.
DONE: all home -> ladder_set mark crew_across false; latch rung_5c_the_backrooms_done.
Owner: "lock for gates and go through them come back to this level if they lead deerer ur exit is on this level"
prompts.br-close-old-levels:
STANDING: 4 or more maps open.
Look: map_count and which maps are finished.
1) Bring pawns and stock home. 2) World tab -> site -> game_execute_gizmo Abandon (abandon_site missing).
Refused: game_take_screenshot of the world tab and read the gizmo label.
DONE: map_count below 4; no mark.
Owner: "you already have 5 colonies builds of colonies open u have too close old ones if u want to open new ones"
prompts.br-company-supply:
STANDING: steel / components / silver below reserve.
Look: steel, components, silver vs STEEL_RESERVE, COMPONENT_RESERVE, TRADE_SILVER_MIN.
0) ladder_set mark company_order_tried false.
1) Mine steel seams first. 2) A bulk-goods trader via the comms console. 3) Company order only if it has to.
Refused: ladder_set mark company_order_tried true (twice -> br-trade-income).
DONE: all three over reserve; no mark.
Owner: "better mine steel or order some trade is your go to once u figure it out"
Owner: "dont use company but if u have to"
prompts.br-trade-income:
ONCE: set up the money machine.
Look: silver, research_current, bill_rows, quest letters.
1) game_set cmd set_zone_plant Plant_Smokeleaf. 2) add_bill RollJoint. 3) Sell to bulk traders; quests for cash.
Refused add_bill: build the table first, or pick a nearby recipe label.
DONE: latch br_trade_income_done.
Owner: "u need cash crops to sell to bulk goods traders and refine them into better products u need research to make money(silver) or order it from company"
Owner: "start growing cash crops"
prompts.gate-assemble:
LIVE: assemble the 4 sections, once.
Look: steel >= 25, components >= 2.
1) add_bill the section on the machining table. 2) Link up to 3 more tables (gate_link missing; game_click_ui_target).
Short of components: br-company-supply. Refused bill: game_list_selected_gizmos on the table for the label.
DONE: all four built -> latch gate_assemble_done.
Owner: "the machining table to op[en the gate needs to be a bill"
prompts.gate-power:
LIVE: power the gate.
Look: has_power, power_generators, comms_console.
Surplus covers the load, reserve for one return, four powered consoles; know where Emergency abort is.
Refused link: game_list_selected_gizmos on the console.
DONE: ladder_set mark gate_online true; latch gate_power_done.
Owner: "we also need an emergy abort option on the gate connection so hold is not the olny option on the backrooms load start"
prompts.gate-open:
LIVE: connect the gate.
Look: hostiles_on_map 0, food ok, nobody in front of the gate.
0) ladder_set mark gate_open_tried false.
1) order_pawn the operator to a console, open option; stay seated until connected.
2) Coordinate shown: ladder_set mark coordinate_held true.
Refused: ladder_set mark gate_open_tried true (2 -> gate-open-fallback).
DONE: ladder_set mark gate_open true; latch gate_open_done.
Owner: "get the gate connected"
prompts.gate-open-fallback:
LIVE: the gate refused to open twice.
0) ladder_set mark gate_open_tried false.
1) Check power and console links (game_list_selected_gizmos). 2) Abort from the load notice if the room is not clear.
Refused again: ladder_set mark gate_open_tried true.
DONE: ladder_set mark gate_open true + coordinate_held true.
Owner: "we also need an emergy abort option on the gate connection so hold is not the olny option on the backrooms load start"
prompts.backrooms-mine:
ONCE: put the held coordinate to work.
Pick one use: mine / farm / storage / prison / saferoom / guest quarters / nugget farm.
Prisoners cross only when zoned and doors allow: game_set cmd set_area.
Refused: game_take_screenshot of the far map, then the designator again.
DONE: latch backrooms_mine_done.
Owner: "remember profiting, u can have a nugget farm in a isolated gate seed if wanted"
prompts.br-gate-ops-cash:
STANDING: silver low -> gate operations for cash.
Look: silver, Operations missions, hostiles_on_map 0, nobody over.
1) Take a mission from Operations (never a hand-ordered crossing). 2) Strip and haul loot home; sell.
Refused: game_open_main_tab Operations, game_get_ui_layout, read the labels.
DONE: silver over TRADE_SILVER_MIN; no mark.
Owner: "machine gate operations of using the bacvkrooms for cash like stripping and taking things to sell and completing misisons"
